Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Assistant-3 role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Under the supervision of the Practice Office Manager/Supervisor, the Medical Assistant assists the Physicians in the care and treatment of patients and is responsible for the maintenance of examination rooms, medical/surgical supplies and equipment.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Prepares patients for medical appointments including obtaining and recording patients’ vital signs.
  • Prepares instruments and equipment for use in examinations and/or medical/surgical procedures.
  • Assists Physicians with examinations and medical procedures.
  • Clean and dress wounds, remove sutures as requested by a Physician.
  • Observes patients and reports adverse reactions to medication or treatment to medical personnel in charge.
  • Collect samples, taken by physician for testing, and deliver them to the laboratory.
  • Cleans, disinfects, and sterilizes materials, instruments, equipment, rooms and supplies.
  • Inventories and requisitions supplies.
  • Reviews patient charts for instructions regarding prescriptions, tests, follow-up appointments and/or patient testing procedures.
  • Schedules patients for follow-up testing procedures.
  • Obtains pre-certification/authorization for surgical procedures, admissions, etc.
  • Assist in locating and filing records.
  • Retrieves lab reports, dictations, x-rays and correspondence. Files and maintains orderly records.
  • Provides patient education and instruction as directed by the Physician. Makes decisions and judgments on phone calls, answering questions and advising patients with Physicians guidelines. Instructs patient in preparation for procedures and in-home care, using instruction sheets when applicable.
  • Answers telephone, takes messages, and gives routine information in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintains knowledge of and complies with established policies and procedures.
  • Maintains work area in a neat and orderly manner. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of examination, diagnostic and treatment room procedures.
  • Knowledge of Medical Terminology.
  • Knowledgeable in the use of CPT and ICD-9 code reference books.
  • Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Demonstrated skill in oral and written communications as well as ability to speak clearly.
  • Skill in assisting in a variety of treatments and medications as directed. Skill in taking vital signs.
  • Skill in maintaining records and recording test results.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with patients, medical staff, and the public.
  • Ability to be detailed oriented, follow established priorities or procedures, and deliver quality customer service.
  • Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions and behave with tact, decorum and diplomacy.
  • Ability to maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations.
  • Ability to read, understand and respond to oral and written instructions.

Minimum Requirements

  • Associate’s degree in Medical Technology, Nursing or related field or two (2) years related experience in a physician’s office, clinic and/or hospital or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Certification or Registration as a Medical Technology also required.

Para compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital da Maternidade Paulino Werneck. Deve cumprir normas de apresentação pessoal, comunicação cordial e empática, manter rigoroso comportamento ético-profissional, participar dos treinamentos e programas de atualização fornecidos pela instituição e colocar em prática os conhecimentos adquiridos. Realizar o registro de todas as informações no prontuário ou impresso padronizado pela instituição, solicitar presença do enfermeiro sempre que for necessário, em situações emergenciais ou imprevistas, avaliar antecipadamente a programação cirúrgica, assegurando a disponibilidade de todo o material cirúrgico necessário, verificar o estoque de material esterilizado, monitorando as datas de esterilização, receber e orientar pacientes e acompanhantes na admissão, explicando a rotina da unidade, preparar a Sala de Operação com os recursos necessários, verificar a temperatura da sala cirúrgica, facilitar o transporte e posicionamento do paciente na mesa de cirurgia, preservando sua privacidade e garantindo a permeabilidade de cateteres e sondas, auxiliar a equipe cirúrgica durante a paramentação e disponibilizar materiais e instrumentais estéreis, garantir o correto posicionamento da placa dispersiva de energia do eletrocautério, verificar o sistema de gases e auxiliar o anestesista durante a indução e reversão da anestesia, exercer as funções de circulante de sala, identificar material para exames anatomopatológicos e encaminhá-lo para serviço especializado, com registro adequado, apoiar o médico neonatologista nos cuidados imediatos do recém-nascido, incluindo a correta identificação com pulseiras e verificação do nome da mãe, desmontar a sala operatória e encaminhar materiais contaminados ao Centro de Material e Esterilização (CME), solicitar limpeza concorrente ou terminal da Sala de Operação, conforme necessário.

title: Assistente de Suprimentos
description:
Job description

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.

  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.

  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.

  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.

  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development/test technologies, tools, and processes
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services

  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Sobre a Atento

Aqui no Grupo Atento – formado também pela empresa Interfile – acreditamos que a melhor experiência do cliente começa com o respeito e cuidado com as pessoas . E isso vale para todo mundo que faz parte da nossa companhia! Se você está em busca da sua primeira oportunidade , ou já tem uma bagagem profissional incrível , o nosso convite é o mesmo: vem crescer com a gente!

Somos líderes como Business Transformation Outsourcing (BTO), combinando tecnologia avançada com o toque humano para revolucionar a experiência do cliente (CX) entre marcas e consumidores globalmente. Estamos em 17 países , com mais de 95 centros de relacionamento e 110 mil postos de trabalho . Atendemos mais de 400 clientes , muitas delas gigantes globais nas áreas de tecnologia, telecom, finanças, saúde, varejo e muito mais.

Juntamos tecnologia + humanização para criar conexões reais e experiências inesquecíveis entre marcas e consumidores. A cada interação, queremos fazer a diferença – enriquecendo vidas e gerando valor para os negócios dos nossos clientes.

Nossa cultura tem nome: One Atento

"One Atento" é a forma que temos de fazer as coisas por aqui – com propósito, união e um olhar sempre voltado para o futuro. São seis valores que nos guiam todos os dias: parceiros estratégicos , cuidamos das nossas pessoas , em equipe vencemos , ágil e simples , mente aberta e entrega de resultados .

O que faz um vendedor PaP?

O vendedor PaP, também conhecido como vendedor externo, faz a prospecção de clientes através de visitas presenciais definidas por rotas ou ações externas, garantindo qualidade de entrega de resultados de vendas.

O que faz um supervisor PaP?

Seu papel é liderar a equipe na busca pelos melhores resultados, garantindo que a equipe siga os direcionamentos, avaliando as entregas e oportunidades propostas, considerando os desafios regionais e o plano comercial!

Temos oportunidades em todos os estados do Brasil.

Para vendedor: ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino fundamental completo e experiência com vendas (de qualquer modalidade).

Para supervisor: ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino médio completo, experiência com vendas e liderança, CNH e veículo próprio.

Como é o processo seletivo?

Você fará seu cadastro, participará de uma entrevista com o RH e depois com o requisitante.

Processo simples e rápido! #VemserAtento!

Na IPNET, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, a flexibilidade. Nossa proposta consiste em trabalhar 2X na semana home-office e 3X presencialmente no escritório. Atualmente, contamos com dois escritórios no Brasil: um no Rio de Janeiro (Zona Portuária/Santo Cristo) e outro em São Paulo (Cidade Monções).

Atuará com a otimização de código, adaptação de kernels e validação de desempenho.

  • Trabalhe com extensões de compiladores (LLVM/GCC) e ISAs especializadas.

  • Analise o desempenho e realize tuning em ambientes paralelos.
  • Colabore com o time na definição de métodos de validação cruzada e coleta de métricas.

É essencial que você tenha...

  • Graduação completa (mínimo 10 anos de formação) em áreas de Computação ou Engenharia.
  • Mestrado e ou Doutorado concluído na área;
  • Experiência com HPC, programação em C/C++ e uso de OpenMP/MPI.
  • Experiência em infraestrutura de compilação (Make, CMake, Compiladores GNU, Intel, Nvidia).

Shape the Future of Global Health, from Vietnam. If you're looking for a mission with global reach, real impact, and a team that scales fast and learns even faster, you’ve just found your next move.

About Elfie

Elfie is the first completely free, gamified mobile app that rewards users for managing their health. Our goal is to become the world’s largest self-reported medical record platform across all therapeutic areas. We operate in 10+ countries today, with plans to expand into 15 by the end of 2025. Try Elfie for yourself by downloading it on the App Store or Google Play.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Elfie, you’ll be at the forefront of shaping how our vision translates into meaningful user and business outcomes. You’ll own end-to-end product experiences, from identifying user needs to defining workflows and shaping solutions that drive real impact in healthcare. You will collaborate closely with founders, engineers, and data teams to ship features that are intuitive, scalable, and strategically aligned. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on solving complex problems with clarity, care, and craft.

What You’ll Get

  • Permanent Global Contract – With a competitive salary
  • Private Healthcare – From day one
  • Top-Tier Tech Setup – Brand new MacBook + full onboarding kit
  • Career Growth Framework – Clear, personalised, and fast-moving
  • 14 Days PTO + Public Holidays – Real time off
  • Hybrid Working – 3 days in the office per week
  • Refreshments – Free Lunch and Dinner every day for you to enjoy

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with founders and the product team to understand business goals, product vision, and service objectives.
  • Translate ideas into clear, actionable design documentation that supports both product specification and engineering implementation.
  • Research, design, and shape end-to-end product experiences for users across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Map out user journeys, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs to explore and communicate design solutions throughout the iterative process.
  • Produce prototypes, visual assets, and interface components to support testing and development.
  • Continuously refine and enhance the product experience based on user insights and feedback.

What You’ll Need

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a UI/UX or product design role, with a strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end mobile app design.
  • Proficient in Figma (required), with additional experience in tools like Adobe Suite considered a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects across fast-paced environments with strong planning, time management, and stakeholder alignment skills.
  • Fluent in English, with clear communication and documentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience in product development is a bonus, especially in software or tech-focused environments.
  • Proactive, self-motivated mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to dive into details to meet goals.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and adapting designs in an iterative, fast-changing product cycle.
  • Solid foundation in visual design, including drawing, color theory, and layout.
  • Portfolio highlights strong visual craft and ability to solve complex interaction problems.
  • Awareness of current trends in mobile UX/UI and game-inspired interfaces. Bonus points for proficiency in Lottie, Rive, or other motion tools.

Why Join Elfie

We’re a global start-up that is mission-led and fiercely product-driven. We’re building something that improves lives with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

What Now?

Apply today for immediate consideration. If you know someone who would be a good fit, we offer a referral reward if your recommendation is hired. Contact Talent Acquisition for more information.

title: Projetista de Tubulação III
description:
Join to apply for the Projetista de Tubulação III role at Proper Marine .

Olá! Somos a Proper Marine , uma empresa do grupo ABL. Nossa missão é oferecer soluções, produtos e serviços de engenharia para a indústria naval e de energia com flexibilidade, tecnologia e segurança, transformando a relação com o cliente, inspirando e desenvolvendo pessoas.

Somos a divisão brasileira da Longitude , consultores globais especializados em design naval, operações marítimas, energias renováveis e transição energética. Com presença em países como EUA, Reino Unido, França, Singapura, Malásia, Filipinas, Austrália e agora no Brasil, através da Proper Marine, fazemos parte do ABL Group – uma consultoria internacional voltada à segurança, sustentabilidade e inovação nos setores de óleo gás, renováveis e marítimo.

Sobre a vaga: O Projetista de Tubulação será responsável pela modelagem, detalhamento e desenvolvimento de projetos de sistemas de tubulação aplicados a embarcações, plataformas e estruturas offshore. Esse profissional terá papel essencial na elaboração de desenhos técnicos, isométricos e listas de materiais, assegurando que todas as soluções estejam alinhadas com os requisitos técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios da indústria naval e offshore.

Formação e experiência

  • Curso Técnico completo em Projetos Mecânicos, Tubulação, Mecânica, Engenharia Naval ou áreas afins.
  • Desejável formação complementar em Engenharia ou cursos de especialização em tubulação industrial/naval.
  • Registro no CREA (para técnicos ou tecnólogos).
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando como projetista de tubulação em ambientes navais, offshore ou óleo gás.
  • Vivência com projetos de sistemas complexos de tubulação a bordo de FPSOs, embarcações de apoio marítimo, sondas, plataformas fixas ou módulos industriais.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e revisar modelos 3D de tubulação usando ferramentas específicas (AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks).
  • Elaborar isométricos, desenhos ortogonais, layouts e listas de materiais (BOM/MTO).
  • Realizar roteamento de linhas considerando espaço, interferências, suporte, manutenção e acessibilidade.
  • Participar de revisões de projeto (model review) com equipes multidisciplinares, propondo soluções de engenharia.
  • Garantir que os desenhos estejam em conformidade com os PIDs, normas de classe e diretrizes do projeto.
  • Verificar interferências e colisões (clash detection) junto às disciplinas de estrutura, elétrica e instrumentação.
  • Preparar documentação técnica de apoio à fabricação e montagem.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e coordenadores de projeto na definição de especificações e padrões técnicos.
  • Apoiar na compatibilização de disciplinas e interface com fornecedores e estaleiros quando necessário.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)

  • Domínio em ferramentas de modelagem e detalhamento de tubulação:
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks, SmartPlant ou equivalentes.
  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas de processo (PID), fluxogramas, plantas e cortes.
  • Conhecimento em materiais e classes de tubulação (carbono, inox, duplex, cobre-níquel etc.)
  • Componentes de sistemas de tubulação: válvulas, flanges, suportes, juntas de expansão, etc.
  • Normas e códigos aplicáveis: ASME B31.3 / B31.1, API, NORSOK, ISO, NR-13, entre outros.
  • Noções de cálculo de suportação e esforço, embora não seja um cargo de engenharia.
  • Experiência com sistemas típicos de embarcações e offshore, como:
  • Sistemas de lastro, incêndio, ar-condicionado, combustível, ar comprimido, água potável e esgoto.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de projeto naval, requisitos de classe (DNV, ABS, BV).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de normas, especificações e comunicação com equipes globais.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Atenção aos detalhes: compromisso com qualidade, precisão e conformidade técnica.
  • Organização: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos entregáveis com eficiência.
  • Comunicação clara: para dialogar com equipes internas, engenheiros, fornecedores e estaleiros.
  • Trabalho em equipe: colaboração ativa com diferentes disciplinas.
  • Proatividade: iniciativa para propor melhorias técnicas e identificar possíveis inconsistências de projeto.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: agilidade para lidar com alterações de escopo e prazos apertados.
  • Comprometimento com prazos e excelência técnica.

Se você tem experiência sólida em projetos de tubulação naval e quer atuar em uma empresa global com foco em engenharia de ponta, segurança e inovação, essa vaga é para você.

Com mais de 6.000 colaboradores espalhados por todo o território nacional, a nossa missão é proteger e cuidar da vida de mais de 56 milhões de pessoas que transitam diariamente por aeroportos, rodovias, shoppings, escolas, empresas, mineradoras e petrolíferas.

title: Executive Operations Director
description:
Executive Operations Director

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: Sarai Bareman

Description

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027").

THE POSITION

The Executive Operations Director, under the guidance of the Executive Tournament Director and in close collaboration with the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup is responsible for the successful operational delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and all related events in accordance with the comprehensive project plan. This includes ensuring the appropriate hosting conditions are provided in collaboration with the host cities, stadium and venue owners, local authorities and third-party entities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leadership & Team Management:
    • Lead and manage the operations team, working closely with all key stakeholders (FIFA Zurich, state and federal government where necessary, host cities, commercial partners, etc.).
    • Ensure effective collaboration between all departments and individuals involved in the tournament's operations.
    • Provide strategic guidance and decision-making during the tournament planning and execution phases.
    • Specifically, the Executive Operations Director shall be responsible for the key operational departments within FIFA27 Brazil, including: Venue Operations, Competitions & Team Services, Safety, security, accreditation & access control, Technology, Events & Entertainment, Medical, Technical Services / Infrastructure, Broadcast and media, Event Services (such as transportation, logistics, travel and accommodation).
  • Operational Planning & Execution:
    • Oversee the operational execution of the FIFA Women’s World Cup, covering all tournament venues, from logistics and planning through to match-day operations.
    • Implement and oversee operational plans, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s goals, budgets, and timelines.
    • Coordinate various functional areas to ensure seamless operations at all venues.
    • Manage the operational budget, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently across all functional areas.
    • Report on financial performance and provide operational cost optimization strategies.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Extensive Experience in Major Sports Events:
    • At least 8-10 years of experience in managing operations for large-scale sports events (e.g. World Cup, Olympic Games, continental championships, etc.).
    • Proven track record of managing cross-functional teams for international sporting events, with an emphasis on logistics, venue management, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Leadership & Management:
    • Strong experience in leading large teams, with the ability to manage diverse and high-performing teams.
    • Previous experience in a senior management role with decision-making authority.
    • Ability to work in high-pressure environments and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Operational Expertise:
    • In-depth knowledge of operational best practices in international sports events, including logistics, security, transportation, and venue operations.
    • Experience managing logistics for major international sporting events, including team operations, transport, logistics, goods delivery.
  • Knowledge of Sports Governance and Regulations:
    • Strong understanding of FIFA regulations, tournament operations, and the international sports governance landscape.
    • Knowledge of the compliance and safety standards required for international events.
  • Crisis Management & Problem Solving:
    • Strong crisis management skills with a proven ability to handle unforeseen challenges during large-scale events.
    • Ability to think quickly and implement solutions under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Management:
    • Proven ability to manage substantial operational budgets and resources.
    • Experience in cost control, optimizing event operations within budget constraints.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
    • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
    • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including sponsors, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
    • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
    • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian) with proficiency in additional languages (e.g., Spanish, French) preferred.

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally. We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally. We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people. We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It is a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amounts that are not billed timely or become aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Fluent English.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more. Our website: Airswift is

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

title: Product Designer Sênior
description:
Overview

Afya Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação! Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica, para trabalhar de forma híbrida na cidade de Rio de Janeiro/São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. Ao assumir o cargo de Product Designer Sênior na Afya, seu objetivo principal será garantir a experiência do usuário nos produtos, visando relacionar tanto os aspectos de usabilidade nas entregas, quanto aspectos de estratégia visando construir uma solução pautada sempre em feedbacks de usuários e em dados relevantes. Você atuará na área de Product Designer dentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto, tecnologia e dados. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e conduzir descobertas a fim de identificar e mapear oportunidades e dores relevantes dos nossos usuários e clientes, por meio de pesquisas e entrevistas com usuários;
  • Propor e participar da experimentação de hipóteses e conceitos, validando-os por meio de pesquisa com usuários, testes A/B, multivariáveis, split tests ou outros métodos de validação, a fim de ajudar na estratégia do produto;
  • Colaborar na definição de indicadores de sucesso e acompanhá-los por meio de follow ups recorrentes, para apoiar as decisões e direcionamentos do negócio;
  • Usar dados no desenvolvimento do projeto para formular hipóteses e sustentar decisões de Design;
  • Facilitar workshops e atividades de concepção junto ao time para guiar o desenvolvimento do produto, a fim de ter uma troca multidiscliplinar;
  • Executar e acompanhar processos de pesquisa com usuários, utilizando seus insights na construção e otimização do produto;
  • Construir e iterar experiências que estejam conectadas com objetivos de negócio e necessidades dos nossos usuários para alavancar a estratégia do produto;
  • Definir novos fluxos; criar interfaces usando nosso design system; criar protótipos de baixa, média e alta fidelidade quando preciso; realizando o handoff e acompanhamento da sua implementação

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Portfólio que mostre impacto real no negócio e na experiência do usuário, incluindo cases de estratégia, simplificação de jornadas e evolução de produto.
  • Experiência sólida em UI Design, com cases que envolvam design systems, mockups, protótipos e microinterações.
  • Vivência em manutenção e escala de design systems, com habilidade para propor, evoluir e escalar componentes.
  • Domínio de princípios e heurísticas de design, boas práticas de UX/UI e proficiência no Figma.
  • Experiência em product discovery e no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais em ambientes web e mobile.
  • Excelente comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e facilitar decisões de produto a partir de argumentos claros e bem estruturados.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e KPIs, sabendo como usá-los para orientar decisões de design.
  • Mentalidade curiosa para explorar e experimentar ferramentas e tecnologias de IA.
  • Interesse em se manter atualizado(a) sobre tendências em IA e aplicá-las nos desafios de design.

Informações adicionais

GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time. Confira os principais abaixo:

Para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
  • Vale-transporte (para vagas Híbridas ou Presenciais);

UP na remuneração:

  • PLR;
  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.

Família, Saúde e Bem-estar:

  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Psicologia Viva (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista);
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D\'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Academia de idiomas (AIA);
  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.

Diferencial para Professor Médico:

  • Assinatura premium do Afya iClinic e Afya Whitebook

description:
Do you enjoy being part of a successful team?

Do you enjoy being part of a successful completion and wellbore intervention team?

Join our team!
We are the leader in well construction and production. Our innovative physical and digital solutions improve production and increase reservoir value. Our Completions Team partners with on-site operators and customers to provide support and guidance to ensure the capacity and value of the well is maximized to its full potential.

Partner with the best
The Service Delivery Coordinator ensures that Baker Hughes maximizes its short and long term revenue, profit and cash collection opportunity by ensuring flawless Service Delivery execution, on time delivery, contract adherence and cash collection for the assigned jobs. This position will coordinate the required job activities across organizational boundaries to ensure the company execute the job in line with customer and company expectations and contract terms and conditions.

As a Service Delivery Coordinator , you will be responsible for:

  • Protecting the health and safety of our personnel and the environment
  • Conduct all activities in line with our core values, and non-negotiables, applicable processes, and cultural pillars

Fuel your passion

  • Have a Bachelor’ Degree in an Engineering or other technical degree with proven experience

Working with us

We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you!

Job description

  • Desenhar e implementar jornadas automatizadas e segmentadas , além de réguas que suportem escalabilidade.

  • Conduzir integrações sistêmicas (APIs, data lakes, ferramentas de CRM) .

Requirements and skills

Experiência

  • Experiência em CRM, Growth ou Marketing de Relacionamento, com histórico em estratégias de conversão e retenção .
  • Ter realizado iniciativas de CRM para produtos digitais complexos e multimarcas , aplicando alavancas proprietárias de crescimento .

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Our Mission

Swapcard is the leading AI-powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in-person and hybrid events. We recognize the importance of teamwork in successful events; that's why Swapcard is fueled by a team of innovators who are passionate about helping organizers build future-proof events.

Our Vision

At Swapcard, we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences.

Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

Our Beliefs

At Swapcard, diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation.

We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.

Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

What you will be doing?

  • Build efficient and robust data pipelines for large volumes of data, from internal databases and SaaS applications, using Fivetran, Airbyte or Python.
  • Develop and optimize transformation data models using Redshift, Dbt, Dagster and other tools.
  • Monitor and maintain our cloud data warehouse (Redshift) with timely and quality data.
  • Set and ensure data engineering standards as part of the department goals.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure data engineering needs/requests are addressed.
  • Create and maintain documentations.

What you should have?

  • 5+ years hands-on experience deploying code in production.
  • At least 2 years of exp with DBT with hands-on experience delivering transformation pipelines with Dbt.
  • Demonstrably deep understanding of SQL and data warehouse.
  • Hands-on experience implementing ETL.
  • Experience working with Python.
  • Experience working with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Kestra, …)
  • At least 4 years of exp with a cloud data warehouse
  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AWS (e.g: Redshift).
  • Experience with Dagster.
  • Experience with data vizualisation tools (e.g Tableau).
  • Knowledge in Infra toolchain (e.g Docker, Terraform, Helm).

Swapcard’s Interview process

Our thorough interview process aims to identify exceptional talent to advance our mission while offering you a chance to explore your career potential at Swapcard.

1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.

2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.

3. Manager review with your future reporting manager

4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders

5. Reference check conducted by our people team

6. Offer

Swapcard's Values

Curious : We ask questions, try new things and take risks. We learn from one another and see mistakes as opportunities to grow—what matters most is how we react and learn from them. We are curious about what something is and why something is. Innovation thrives when curiosity drives.

Value-Driven: At Swapcard, we focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value for our customers, team members, and partners.

Human : At Swapcard, being human means fostering empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community. We’re driven by a strong team spirit and a shared goal of building meaningful connections—both through our product and within our team.

Resilient : We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability, constantly seeking innovative solutions and opportunities for growth.

Ownership: At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. True ownership means more than just completing tasks; it's about being proactive, investing ourselves fully in the outcomes, and fostering a culture of trust.

Benefits & Reasons to Join Swapcard

  • International team with 40+ nationalities (more on the way!)
  • Remote-first policy with headquarters in Paris
  • Thriving startup with career growth opportunities
  • Open-minded culture that appreciates differences
  • Feedback-driven, supportive & curious team with a DIY mindset
  • Generous Paid Time Off to ensure you have time for what matters most
  • Remote perks designed to optimize your working experience
  • In-person social gatherings to celebrate our achievements
  • 100% of your health insurance contribution paid by Swapcard
  • Work-from-home budget (one-off contribution for equipment in addition to your initial equipment setup)
  • Co-working space budget to support remote work in professional environments
  • Learning budget to help you develop new and existing skills
  • Mental health care initiatives to support your well-being

Equal Opportunity

Swapcard is committed to upholding equal employment practices and making merit-based employment decisions. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences to apply, regardless of race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy status, age, marital status, and status as a veteran

description:
Segmento: Não Informado

Atividades:

This is a high-profile project management position where customer relationship management and advocacy for Canonical's technical assets are strategically crucial.

You will be responsible for working with all stakeholders in the development of project statements of work (SoW).

You will be required to create, manage, and maintain project-specific schedules ensuring projects are delivered within the time, resources, and scope expectations and meet the desired business outcomes.

You will be responsible for managing multiple projects simultaneously.

The Devices IoT Project Manager is expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Regular preparation of project reports for management regarding the status of projects will be required.

Finally, the role is responsible for managing the project through its complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met.

Periodic international travel is required. Travel amount and duration will vary based on company and project requirements.

As a Project Manager you will:

  • Successfully deliver professional engineering services for assigned projects
  • Assist in development of project statements of work
  • Draft and maintain project-specific schedules / project plans
  • Obtain client agreement to the project schedule and work items
  • Ensure projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Manage project risk mitigation and plans
  • Drive technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Manage delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keep management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identify custom engineering requests outside existing contracts
  • Advocate to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio
  • Support different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required

The successful Project Manager will have:

  • Project management experience in a computer-oriented / technical service field, ideally with Internet-connected devices
  • Degree level education, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the open-source community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Extensive experience managing projects with cross-cultural, multi-continent resources, preferably in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Excellent communication skills in English
  • Strong leadership and problem-solving skills, with experience building successful partnerships
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 certification preferred
  • Willingness to travel occasionally domestically and internationally
  • Ability to work non-standard hours to support global teams

About Canonical

Canonical is a growing international software company working with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, the world's #1 cloud operating system.

Our mission is to realize the potential of free software for individuals and organizations.

Our services help businesses reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enhance security with Ubuntu.

We offer learning and development, competitive salaries, recognition rewards, annual leave, travel passes, and flexible working options.

Canonical values diversity and is committed to equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals.

  • Supervisionar o cumprimento das atribuições da assistência;
  • Colaborar com serviço de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento, participando das atividades de estudo;
  • Assegurar condições adequadas de assistência, fornecendo ferramentas operacionais;
  • Participar na avaliação de materiais teste;
  • Observar a atividade dos profissionais de Enfermagem durante o plantão, orientando-os quanto à adequação e realização dos procedimentos;
  • Verificar a presença dos funcionários de enfermagem, conferindo as faltas, atrasos e licenças, realizando os remanejamentos necessários;
  • Acompanhar o maior número possível de atendimentos prestados por profissionais de Enfermagem, intervindo, sempre que julgar necessário;
  • Atuar e coordenar atendimentos em situações de emergência, e ainda, assumindo os pacientes na ausência de plantonista;
  • Realizar a Supervisão Geral sempre que necessário;
  • Registrar as deficiências verificadas no desempenho dos profissionais de Enfermagem do plantão para posterior solicitação de correção específica;
  • Controlar e supervisionar a execução de rotinas de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais e equipamentos durante o plantão;
  • Conhecer e fazer cumprir as rotinas de Enfermagem estabelecidas;
  • Controlar e supervisionar o armazenamento, distribuição e manutenção de materiais e equipamentos nos setores durante o plantão;
  • Estabelecer, controlar e supervisionar o registro de informações no livro de ordens e ocorrências durante o plantão;
  • Realizar abordagem educativa sempre que visualizar não conformidades ou condutas anti-profissionais;
  • Apaziguar as situações de conflito, sejam elas de paciente x equipe, equipe x equipe, equipe x instituição;
  • Realizar bundle de manutenção de dispositivos diariamente;
  • Participar do acolhimento dos familiares durante a visita nos setores fechados (CTI).

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino superior em Enfermagem;
  • Experiência mínima assistencial e de gestão de um ano em terapia intensiva, atuação em CTI coronariano, hemodinâmica e/ou emergência de grande porte (sala de trauma).
  • Pacote office (informática), indicadores em saúde, educação em saúde, análise de prontuários.

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Sua missão será liderar um time de vendas consultivas, acompanhando de perto os indicadores, traçando planos de ação para o alcance do resultado esperado, focando no desenvolvimento dos seus liderados, fornecendo feedbacks constantes, construindo planos de desenvolvimento individual e de carreira e trazendo ações para reforçar a cultura de foco no(a) cliente dentro da companhia.

title: Manager, Overlay Cluster
description:
Manager, Overlay Cluster

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Implement change management processes and maintain budget control for venues under your responsibility. Organize, coordinate, and oversee the flow of technical information (e.g., drawings, requirements, updates) across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain clear communication with stadium authorities to ensure alignment on timelines, by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Work closely with overlay delivery partners from planning through construction and removal, monitoring the execution of the project scope to ensure all requirements are met and that spaces are handed over on time and to the expected quality throughout all project phases, including reinstatement.
  • Provide regular updates on overlay progress at assigned venues, track project milestones and deliverables, and support timely resolution of issues or delays.
  • Support operational design development by transforming raw data into accurate base CAD drawings, integrating operational, overlay, and legacy content, and ensuring all updates adhere to FIFA standards and templates. Delivering complete and timely drawing sets aligned with project schedules and inspection requirements.
  • Align and establish a clear and consistent code/naming convention for commodities to be integrated into the design, enabling effective status tracking and change management control.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Availability to travel as needed

title: Senior Enterprise Architect - Tietoevry Care (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

At Tietoevry Care you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About us

Tietoevry Care is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About the role

We are looking for a strategic and visionary Enterprise Architect who can define, lead, and align our technology strategy across the entire healthcare platform ecosystem. In this role, you will

  • Set the architectural direction for our platform products
  • Oversee alignment across different products
  • Ensure long-term scalability, interoperability, and maintainability
  • Support international expansion into the wider European healthcare market

You will engage directly with

  • Customers to explore new clinical and operational workflows, and digital transformation needs
  • Partners to co-develop, integrate, and ensure compatibility within a modular platform ecosystem
  • Product Management and Product Owners to align architectural vision with product strategies and roadmaps

As an Enterprise Architect, you will

  • Define and evolve the enterprise-wide architecture for our healthcare platform products
  • Align architecture across product teams, domains, and business stakeholders
  • Drive adherence to healthcare standards such as openEHR, FHIR, and HL7
  • Lead strategic architectural initiatives such as modularization, capability-based planning, and platform evolution
  • Govern architecture principles and ensure compliance across all layers (business, application, data, and infrastructure)
  • Act as a key advisor to business and product leadership regarding technology roadmaps and transformation programs
  • Guide solution and software architects and foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
  • Contribute to technology partner strategies, vendor evaluations, and interoperability initiatives

We are looking for someone with:

  • Broad experience in enterprise architecture across complex product ecosystems
  • Deep understanding of architecture principles / frameworks
  • Proven ability to align business and technology strategies
  • Familiarity with open digital health platforms and healthcare-specific standards (openEHR, FHIR)
  • Experience designing scalable and modular architecture in cloud-native and containerized environments
  • Leadership experience in driving change and enterprise-wide architecture governance
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including international and partner collaboration

As a person you are:

  • Strategic in your thinking and system-minded
  • Collaborative and able to work across different teams, organizations and cultures
  • Committed to excellence and long-term impact
  • Curious, open-minded, and adaptable

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tietoevry has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Kari-Antti Kuosa ( )

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tietoevry declines calls from recruitment companies.

About Tietoevry

Tietoevry creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, wework with our customers to develop digitalfutureswhere businesses, societies, and humanitythrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public-sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tietoevry’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

At Tietoevry, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders, and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Principal Accountabilities

The Associate Director of Ventures and Entrepreneurship is responsible for leading the strategic development and operational execution of entrepreneurial and venture creation initiatives within the Office of Research’s Technology Transfer & Commercialization Unit. Reporting to the Director of Technology Transfer & Commercialization, this role plays a critical leadership position in expanding the university’s innovation ecosystem by supporting the formation, incubation, and growth of university-affiliated startups and faculty−, student−, and community−led ventures.

Key Accountabilities Include

  • Designing and implementing programs that translate Howard University’s research, intellectual property, and creative works into viable startup and spinout companies.
  • Leading the Grow|HU and Venture|HU initiatives by managing entrepreneurial pipelines, spinout support services, and venture−readiness programming.
  • Building and maintaining a network of venture capitalists, angel investors, alumni entrepreneurs, and industry mentors to provide capital and guidance to emerging ventures.
  • Working in close coordination with internal partners (e.g., Office of Corporate Relations, Office of the General Counsel, Office of Innovation & Economic Development, Schools and Colleges) to align commercialization and venture goals across the university.
  • Advising faculty, students, and staff on business model development, startup formation, and investment strategies tailored to deep tech, life sciences, software, and creative sector ventures.
  • Establishing performance metrics and reporting mechanisms for tracking startup creation, funding secured, and economic impact from entrepreneurial activities.
  • Representing Howard University at national and regional convenings focused on inclusive innovation, HBCU entrepreneurship, and university spinouts.
  • Managing program staff, budgetary resources, and strategic partnerships that strengthen Howard’s capacity to serve as a launchpad for underrepresented founders and scalable ventures.
  • Supporting the Director in institutional planning and fundraising efforts that enhance the university’s visibility and competitiveness in translational research and startup acceleration.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. title: Job Page | Auxiliar Produção (Exclusiva PCD)
description:
Visão geral

Job type: Full-time employee. Auxiliar Produção

Se você se identifica com nosso propósito de promover acesso à saúde para que todas as pessoas possam viver mais e melhor e quer trabalhar em uma empresa empreendedora, inovadora, ética e sustentável, queremos te convidar para participar de nosso processo seletivo.

Venha fazer parte da Eurofarma, uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar do país, segundo o #GPTW !

Valorizamos nossas pessoas e acreditamos que uma boa experiência na empresa é a chave do sucesso para que possamos oferecer os melhores produtos e medicamentos para o nosso consumidor.

Aqui você pode ser quem você é. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas!

Responsabilidades

  • Prestar auxílio geral na produção (Embalagem, Envase, Manipulações, Preparação de Materiais e Limpeza Técnica das áreas limpas), de modo a garantir o suporte a área e o andamento dos processos produtivos;
  • Realizar o preenchimento e conferência das informações inseridas nos documentos de produção, de modo a documentar as atividades realizadas na área e nos equipamentos garantindo a rastreabilidade futura;
  • Fornecer auxilio na execução dos set up dos equipamentos, limpeza, organização, abastecimento de materiais produtivos e preparação de materiais deixando de acordo com as especificações da ordem de produção afim de zelar pelo bom funcionamento do processo produtivo;
  • Apoiar na conferência dos materiais recebidos (quant/NC e Lote) recebidos do almoxarifado para devida liberação da linha, assim como nas devoluções ao almoxarifado verificando se está de acordo com o fechamento da OP ;
  • Auxiliar nos controles de Processo de produção Ex: testes de vedação etc, como também Identificações de Equipamentos, quadro de produtividade e de produtos na linha a fim de garantir a identificação real do fluxo de produção;
  • Efetuar leitura de temperaturas, umidade, pressões das áreas, garantindo a produção dos medicamentos de acordo com os parâmetros especificados;
  • Auxiliar no funcionamento dos equipamentos de baixa, média e alta complexidade dando andamento no processo produtivo;
  • Realizar o abastecimento da linha e equipamento (Carregamento e descarregamento), com os materiais utilizados na produção por exemplo válvulas e frascos, garantindo o andamento da linha de produção;
  • Efetuar as movimentações de materiais necessários ao consumo de modo a garantir a agilidade no andamento do processo;
  • Manter a organização, limpeza, conservação e organização do local de trabalho, assim como executar todas as atividades conforme BPF (Boas Práticas de Fabricação);
  • Realizar a limpeza e preparação de utensílios, peças de equipamentos, equipamentos de proteção individual, assegurando a qualidade do produto a ser fabricado.
  • Executar a limpeza utilizando utensílios para área limpa (sala de envase, corredores de acesso antecâmaras e vestiários) do teto, parede e chão conforme procedimentos de limpeza estabelecidos pelo departamento de validação durante o set up;
  • Transporte e abastecimento de materiais e bulks (Bins, gaiolas e etc) para linha de embalagem utilizando paleteira elétrica ou hidráulica;

Entre outras atividades pertinentes à area.

Requisitos

  • Experiência na área;
  • Conhecimentos de Normas de Segurança;
  • Condução de empilhadeiras será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos no sistema SAP será um diferencial.

Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale transporte/Estacionamento - de acordo com a unidade de trabalho;
  • Farmácia/Dispensário com medicamentos gratuitos para você, pais, cônjuge e filhos;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência privada para que possa planejar seu futuro;
  • Tem filhos? Você terá direito à auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Salão de beleza para que possa cuidar de você;
  • Convênio com rede de Academias para cuidar da sua saúde;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento, que oferecem parcerias em instituições de ensino com desconto;
  • Licença maternidade
  • Licença paternidade estendida
  • Horário : Disponibilidade para turnos, 44h semanais

06h00 às 15h00 ou 12h00 às 21h00

Sábados alternados

Sobre a Eurofarma

Eurofarma Laboratórios é uma multinacional brasileira presente em 22 países, com mais de 50 anos de história e o propósito de promover acesso à saúde para que todas as pessoas possam viver mais e melhor. É isso que move a Eurofarma todos os dias.

Com mais de 11 mil colaboradores, atuamos em todos os principais segmentos farmacêuticos e somos líderes em receituário médico no Brasil.

Sabemos do nosso importante papel de transformação na sociedade, entendendo que as pessoas são fundamentais na trajetória de crescimento, ao lado dos resultados, internacionalização, inovação e sustentabilidade, para nos tornarmos cada vez mais globais. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento profissional de nossos colaboradores, a diversidade e a inclusão. Buscamos pluralidade de perfis, gêneros, raças, orientações e identidades, pois acreditamos que contribuições e percepções de pessoas distintas nos ajudam a encontrar, juntos, soluções novas e sustentáveis em saúde.

Aqui você pode ser quem você é. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas!

  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • CNH B.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência profissional na área de vendas de softwares e serviços de CAD/CAM/MES.

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

  1. Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  2. Implement change management processes and maintain budget control for venues under your responsibility. Organize, coordinate, and oversee the flow of technical information (e.g., drawings, requirements, updates) across all venues in the cluster.
  3. Maintain clear communication with stadium authorities to ensure alignment on timelines, by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  4. Work closely with overlay delivery partners from planning through construction and removal, monitoring the execution of the project scope to ensure all requirements are met and that spaces are handed over on time and to the expected quality throughout all project phases, including reinstatement.
  5. Provide regular updates on overlay progress at assigned venues, track project milestones and deliverables, and support timely resolution of issues or delays.
  6. Support operational design development by transforming raw data into accurate base CAD drawings, integrating operational, overlay, and legacy content, and ensuring all updates adhere to FIFA standards and templates. Delivering complete and timely drawing sets aligned with project schedules and inspection requirements.
  7. Align and establish a clear and consistent code/naming convention for commodities to be integrated into the design, enabling effective status tracking and change management control.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Availability to travel as needed

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.
